title: Convert repo into self-contained uv skill

observation: Development work should use a structured worklog, prefer simple changes, and validate with existing tests when possible.
Use structured worklog tools as source of truth; record meaningful observations, add tasks before implementation, and finish/cancel all tasks before completion.

README currently presents the project as a PyPI-installable CLI, recommends `uv tool install google-search-console-cli`, includes `uv tool` upgrade/uninstall instructions, and has a Publishing section for PyPI workflows.
The skill manifest currently lives under a nested skills/google-search-console directory and requires an installed `gsc` command in prerequisites; command examples use `gsc` directly.
Repository has a PyPI publishing workflow triggered by version tags and workflow_dispatch, building distributions and publishing with trusted publishing.
Setup script already uses uv but runs `uv sync --extra dev`, checks `.venv/bin/gsc`, and then invokes `uv run gsc auth login`; this can be simplified for no-install uv-run usage.

Project defines the `gsc` script entry point (`gsc_cli.cli:cli`) and dev extra for pytest, so `uv run --project <skill-root> gsc ...` and `uv run --project <skill-root> pytest` can execute from a copied skill folder without global installation.

title: Move the Google Search Console skill manifest to the repository root and rewrite it for self-contained uv-run usage.
Remove PyPI publishing artifacts and nested skill directory structure that conflict with a self-contained skill folder.
Update README and setup script so all user-facing commands run via uv without global or PyPI installation.
Validate the converted skill with uv-run help/tests and review the git diff.
Commit the completed changes with the structured worklog.
